paragraphs: This is the reading in Jerusalem Talmud Taanit, chapter 4, halakhah 1. Hyman calls it an evident scribal error for bar Pazi, as stated explicitly in Berakhot, chapter 4, halakhah 1, with the additional printed locator כח:.[^1][^2]

notes.text: ה״א-כח: combines Berakhot 4h 1 with an additional historical locator כח:, kept literal rather than asserting a modern Bavli 28b. Earlier machine ה״אדכח: differs from the supplied hyphen, possibly involving a folio marker; no source-image resolution or specific edition is claimed. Taanit is explicitly Jerusalem Talmud, with Berakhot’s corpus inferred rather than repeated.

ט״ס דמוכח שצ״ל preserves Hyman’s evident scribal-error judgment and claimed explicit bar-Pazi parallel, not a fresh corrected identity or adopted heading. The abbreviated heading title stays R'; catalog רבי does not expand it.
